messages.subject: Re: mirt 1.2.1 released to CRAN
parts:
Hi Danilo,

There are slides, exercise files, and examples from past presentations
on Github, https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt. Additionally, the
package is loaded with example analyses for each function, so just use
?mirt or some other function and check out how they work. Cycling
through help index is also good, since functions like plot() for the
S4 objects are kind of hard to document in R.... Cheers.

Phil
